metric_definitions.letter_agreement: Letter F1/precision/recall on edit-aligned token pairs (token-edit-alignment-v1); abstention gaps preserved before alignment. Global LCS is diagnostic only.
metric_definitions.surface_exact: Exact surface matches among edit-aligned pairs after letter-fold (casefold + strip diacritics + letters only). Recall = exact hits / gold tokens. Strict index-positional diagnostics are separate.
metric_definitions.lemma_proxy: Lemma/inflection accuracy unmeasured: JAK-37 infer_greek_lemma only strips combining marks and duplicates greek_letters_only / surface_exact; cannot detect παραβολη vs παραβολην. Not an independent gate signal.
metric_definitions.lemma_lcs: Longest common subsequence length of letter-folded surfaces / gold token count — order-preserving content recovery (not lemma morphology).
metric_definitions.near_miss_tokens: Edit-aligned pairs with shared letters but not exact surface match (weak near-miss signal; not morphology accuracy).
metric_definitions.word_order: Order-sensitive: edit alignment charges substitutions/insertions/deletions; reordering that loses position lowers aligned surface scores even when surface-LCS stays high.
metric_definitions.phrase_fidelity: Actual source-span-localized phrase fidelity is unavailable. construction_phrase_hits reports an unlocalized whole-verse phrase occurrence diagnostic only (not mapping fidelity).
metric_definitions.additions_omissions: From token-level edit alignment: insertions (unsupported hyp tokens), deletions (omitted gold tokens), and substitutions. Not length-only sequence-length differences.
metric_definitions.uncertainty: Decoder span abstention rate + mean top-1 candidate uncertainty when candidates exist. Coverage is source-token coverage from input_span.token_ids; span_coverage is reported separately.
metric_definitions.surviving_letter_thomas7: Official Thomas 7 surviving-letter agreement requires ``review_status=human-checked`` + freeze pin whose digest matches the frozen reconstruction (JAK-40). Gate-blocked status is reported honestly; not invented.
